review_status: draft v1 - deep wreck jack profile

profile.diet: Crabs, squids, and small reef fishes
profile.behavior: Pelagic jack that frequents deep artificial reefs, wrecks, and high-relief drop-offs.

factors.reason_template: Water is {value} C, favorable for African pompano.
factors.value_notes: No traceable species-specific field, tagging, or physiological source was located that validates the configured 22–29 °C range or 24–27 °C ideal as a wild African pompano SST preference. The STRI account documents tropical distribution and habitat but does not report a thermal preference. Retain the existing band only as an unvalidated screening assumption; this factor is an active eligibility input.

factors.reason_template: Structure is {value}, where African pompano gather.
factors.value_notes: The STRI Greater Caribbean species account describes adults in coastal seas, a reef-associated/benthopelagic habitat, and a broad water-column relationship. It does not directly validate the exact wreck/artificial-reef/natural-reef/ledge preference ordering or the numeric map scores. Treat category rankings as provisional model assumptions.

factors.reason_template: Depth is {value} m, in deep wreck zone.
factors.value_notes: The STRI Greater Caribbean species account reports a depth range of 0–100 m. This supports broad depth use but does not validate the configured 20–120 m outer band or 35–80 m ideal; the upper configured limit exceeds the cited species-account range. Depth is an active gate.
